results.rationale: ts-preserve-service shows near-onset CPU and memory anomalies (1733591947), with downstream explanation confirming high-latency calls to ts-contacts-service, ts-security-service, and ts-order-service at or before their symptom onset. These callees exhibit only latency/workload signals without internal mechanism. No other candidate has comparable multi-service impact: ts-auth-service logs are non-error INFO and latency declined; ts-auth-mongo has no dependent service evidence; ts-consign-service impacts only one callee. Counterfactual trace paths and downstream timing strongly support preserve as the initiating faulty component. Therefore, ts-preserve-service is the root cause with cpu saturation as the mechanism.
uncertainties: absence of explicit error logs from preserve
